name: Laundromat
fix_description: In deposit, the msg.value check is commented out (//if(msg.value != payment) throw). Uncomment it to require depositors to send exactly the required payment amount. Without this check, anyone can register a pubkey without depositing ETH, then withdraw other participants funds.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: flash-loan BUSD, swap into UN, abuse the pair via repeated token transfers plus skim() to distort balances/reserves behavior, then swap back for profit and repay. It requires understanding Uniswap V2 pair mechanics and skim-based reserve/balance manipulation, making it more involved than a trivial access-control bug but not a deeply complex multi-protocol chain.
